app.name: Pirut
app.tagline: Understand your Israeli credit card spending

auth.setupIntro: This creates the first household account. Members you add later share the same transactions.
auth.loginIntro: Sign in to reach the household's transactions.

status.heading: System status
status.degraded: The application is running but the database is unavailable

settings.heading: Settings
settings.passkeysIntro: A passkey signs you in with this device instead of a password.
settings.passkeysNote: Passkeys work only when Pirut is opened over HTTPS or from localhost.
settings.passkeysEmpty: No passkey is registered yet. Add one to sign in without typing a password.
settings.passkeyNameHint: Something you will recognise later, such as the device you are using.
settings.householdIntro: Every member sees and imports the same transactions.
settings.memberAdded: {{name}} can sign in from now on.
settings.removeMemberConfirm: Remove {{name}}? They lose access to Pirut, and the transactions they imported stay.

import.heading: Import a statement
import.fileHint: Choose the Excel (.xlsx) statement you downloaded from the card issuer.
import.privacyNote: The file is read on your own machine to build the preview, and the file itself is never kept.
import.nothingToImport: Every row in this statement is already stored, so there is nothing left to import.
import.importedResult: Imported {{inserted}} transactions and skipped {{skipped}} that were already stored.
import.alreadyImportedResult: This exact file was imported before, so nothing changed.

transactions.heading: Transactions
transactions.selectMonth: Choose a month to see its transactions.
transactions.noDataYet: Nothing has been imported yet. Import a statement and your months will appear here.
transactions.emptyMonth: No transactions are stored for this month. Pick another month, or import the statement that covers it.

errors.notAStatement: This file does not look like a card statement. Download the statement again from the issuer, then choose the new file.
errors.statementDoesNotReconcile: The rows in this file do not add up to the total it states, so nothing was imported. Download the statement again and try once more.
errors.unsupportedFile: Only Excel (.xlsx) statements can be imported. Export the statement as Excel and choose that file.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is too large to import. Choose a single monthly statement rather than a full export.
errors.invalidFilter: That month cannot be shown. Choose a month from the list above.
errors.internal: Something went wrong while handling the file. Try again, and if it keeps failing, check the server logs.
errors.network: The application server did not answer. Check that it is running, then try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on.
errors.setupAlreadyCompleted: Pirut is already set up. Sign in with the account that was created.
errors.invalidMember: Check the name and the email address, then try again.
errors.memberExists: That email address already belongs to a member. Use a different address.
errors.weakPassword: The password is too short. Choose one of at least {{min}} characters.
errors.cannotRemoveSelf: You cannot remove your own account. Ask another member to remove it for you.
errors.lastMember: The last member cannot be removed, because someone has to keep access. Add another member first.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are different. Type the same password in both fields.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email address and password do not match an account. Check them and try again.
errors.invalidOrigin: Pirut did not recognise the address this page was opened from. Set PIRUT_PUBLIC_URL to that address, or add it to PIRUT_TRUSTED_ORIGINS, then restart.
errors.emailNotVerified: This account still has to confirm its email address before it can sign in.
errors.signInFailed: Signing in did not work. Try again, and if it keeps failing check the server logs.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.passkeyFailed: The passkey did not work. Try again, or sign in with your password.
errors.passkeyCancelled: The passkey prompt closed before it finished. Try again when you are ready.
errors.passkeyNotFound: This passkey is no longer registered. Sign in with your password, then add a new passkey.
errors.passkeyAlreadyRegistered: This device already has a passkey for Pirut. Use it to sign in.
errors.passkeyAddFailed: The passkey was not added. Try again, and make sure Pirut is open over HTTPS or from localhost.
errors.passkeyRemoveFailed: The passkey was not removed. Try again.
errors.passkeysUnavailable: The passkeys could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.membersUnavailable: The member list could not be loaded. Try again.

foundation.notice: A personal project. Statements are parsed on your own machine and only the parsed transactions are stored.
